title: Server Administrator
description:
**About This Job**
**Actowiz Solutions**
**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India
   

  

**Work Mode:** 
 On\-site
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Data Infrastructure and Analytics
   

  

**Job Description**
 Server Executive
   

  

 1\-2 years
   

  

 Ahmedabad
   

  

 Full\-Time
   

  

**Required Skills**
 1–2 years of hands\-on experience in Server Administration / System Administration / Hosting Support.Strong knowledge of Linux/Ubuntu Server administration.Good working knowledge of Apache and Nginx.Experience managing VPS, cloud, and dedicated servers.Good understanding of DNS and domain configuration, including A, CNAME, MX, TXT, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records.Experience with SSL certificate installation, renewal, and troubleshooting.Working knowledge of PHP server environments and PHP extensions.Basic to intermediate knowledge of MySQL/MariaDB.Good understanding of SSH, SFTP/FTP, Cron Jobs, permissions, users, and Linux commands.Experience with server monitoring including CPU, RAM, disk space, bandwidth, server load, and uptime.Knowledge of server backup, restore, and migration.Basic understanding of firewalls, server security, SSH hardening, and access control.Ability to troubleshoot 500, 502, 503, 504, DNS, SSL, database, and connectivity issues.Ability to manage and monitor multiple domains and servers simultaneously.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Manage, monitor, and maintain servers supporting 15\+ company domains, websites, applications, and databases.Monitor server health, uptime, CPU, RAM, disk usage, bandwidth, and overall performance.Configure and maintain Apache/Nginx, PHP, MySQL/MariaDB, Virtual Hosts, and SSL.Manage domain and DNS configurations and troubleshoot DNS\-related issues.Install, configure, renew, and troubleshoot SSL certificates.Perform server deployment, configuration, migration, and maintenance activities.Monitor and maintain regular website and database backups and perform restoration when required.Configure and monitor Cron Jobs and automated server tasks.Troubleshoot website, application, database, email, DNS, SSL, and server\-related issues.Monitor server logs and identify errors, abnormal activity, and potential performance issues.Maintain server security, firewall rules, user permissions, SSH access, and security updates.Monitor and troubleshoot SMTP/email delivery, mail queues, and server\-related email issues where applicable.Coordinate with PHP, Python, SEO, Digital Marketing, and other technical teams for server\-related requirements.Support developers during application deployment and production releases.Maintain documentation of servers, domains, IPs, databases, configurations, backups, and incidents.Respond quickly to server downtime, critical alerts, and infrastructure\-related incidents.Proactively identify potential server issues and take preventive action before they impact websites or applications.
   

  

**Preferred Skills**
 Experience with AWS, Digital Ocean, Azure, or other cloud platforms.Experience with Cloudflare and CDN configuration.Knowledge of Docker and containerized applications.Basic knowledge of Git/GitHub and deployment workflows.Experience deploying Python, Node.js, or other web applications.Knowledge of Redis, Elasticsearch, or other application services.Experience with CI/CD and automated deployment.Familiarity with server monitoring tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Zabbix, or similar tools.Knowledge of Linux server hardening and security best practices.Experience with server migration and disaster recovery.Basic knowledge of SMTP, PHP Mailer, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.Experience handling high\-traffic websites, data processing servers, or web scraping infrastructure will be an advantage.

title: Yardi Administrator
description:
**About the Company:** 




 Relay Human Cloud is a young \& dynamic company that helps some of the top US\-based companies to expand their team internationally. Relay is a truly global company having its operations in US, India, Honduras, and Mexico (We are also adding a few more countries soon). Our core focus is to enable companies to connect with the best international talent. Relay helps its clients in majorly following areas: Accounting \& Finance, Administration, Operations, Space Planning, Leasing, Data Science, Data Search, Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence etc. Relay India operates from Ahmedabad and Vadodara offices. The principals and founders of Relay Human Cloud have been focused on delivering high\-quality operations in cutting\-edge companies for their entire careers.
 



  





**Job Summary** 




 The ideal candidate will possess a strong understanding of property management operations, affordable housing programs, and Yardi Voyager administration. This individual will collaborate across departments to streamline business processes, improve reporting capabilities, and ensure users maximize the value of our technology investments.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**System Administration** 



* Administer and maintain the Yardi Voyager platform and related modules.
* Configure user accounts, roles, security permissions, and workflows.
* Monitor system performance and coordinate software updates, patches, and enhancements.
* Maintain data integrity through regular audits and system maintenance.



**User Support \& Training** 



* Serve as the primary point of contact for Yardi\-related support requests.
* Troubleshoot system issues and coordinate resolutions with Yardi Support when necessary.
* Develop user documentation, training materials, and standard operating procedures.
* Conduct onboarding and ongoing training for new and existing employees.



**Business Process Improvement** 



* Partner with Accounting, Property Management, Compliance, and Leadership to identify opportunities for automation and operational efficiencies.
* Analyze existing workflows and recommend system improvements.
* Support implementation of new Yardi modules and functionality.



**Reporting \& Data Management** 



* Develop, maintain, and enhance operational and financial reports using Yardi reporting tools.
* Assist leadership with dashboard development and performance metrics.
* Ensure accurate data management across properties and portfolios.



**Affordable Housing \& Compliance Support** 



* Support system configuration for affordable housing programs including LIHTC, Section 8, PRA, and other subsidized housing programs.
* Ensure system configurations align with HUD, investor, and regulatory requirements.
* Assist compliance teams with reporting and audit preparation.



**Integration \& Technology Support** 



* Coordinate integrations between Yardi and third\-party applications.
* Assist with data imports, exports, and system conversions.
* Participate in technology initiatives and cross\-functional projects.



  





**Qualifications** 




**Required** 



* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, Accounting, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Minimum of 3 years of Yardi Voyager administration experience.
* Strong understanding of property management and property accounting.
* Experience with security administration, workflows, reporting, and system configuration.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.



**Preferred** 



* Experience supporting affordable housing portfolios (LIHTC, Section 8, HUD, PRA).
* Experience with Yardi Procure to Pay, RentCafe, CRM, Payment Processing, or other Yardi modules.
* Knowledge of SQL, Power BI, SSRS, or other business intelligence tools.
* Experience managing software implementations and upgrades.



  





**Why Join Relay Human Cloud? ✨** 




 🌍 Opportunities to work with global clients
 



 🤝 Dynamic and collaborative work environment
 



 ⚖️ Excellent work\-life balance – 5\-day workweek
 



 🩺 Comprehensive health \& accident insurance
 



 🌴 Generous paid time off and holidays
 



 🍽️ Complimentary lunches \& dinners
 



 🏆 Quarterly, Semi\-Annual \& Annual recognition, rewards, and giveaways
 



 📚 Employee development programs – Communication, Soft Skills, and more
 



 🎉 Vibrant cultural events – Fun Fridays, Month\-End Celebrations, Sports Tournaments, and Festival celebrations
 



 🎯 Excellent Employee Referral Program

title: Senior Golang Engineer - Observability Preferred
description:
**Role \- Senior Golang Engineer \- Observability Preferred** 




**Experience: 3\+ Years** 




**Location: Ahmedabad** 




  





**Position Overview:** 




  





 We are looking for a systems\-minded developer with 3–5 years of hands\-on experience who is comfortable
 



 working close to the machine in Go/Rust, and equally comfortable reasoning about distributed behavior
 



 across a cloud\-native deployment. The ideal candidate has worked in the observability domain — metrics,
 



 logs, traces, time\-series storage and enjoys owning a module end to end. This is a high\-ownership role in a
 



 small, fast\-moving team. You will work across multiple modules, make design calls, use AI\-assisted
 



 development as a daily tool, and be accountable for what you ship in production.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibility:** 




  





**•** 
 Build and scale services for operational data ingestion, enrichment, storage, and query in a
 



 multitenant SaaS environment — spanning push\-based telemetry (metrics, logs, traces), polland protocol\-based collection (SNMP, WMI, SSH, ICMP), event streams (traps, syslog, flow), and
 



 discovery and inventory data.
 



 • Work with event/message\-driven pipelines (NATS) and time\-series, relational, and cache
 



 stores.
 



 • Design ingestion paths that handle heterogeneous sources and cadences — high\-volume
 



 streaming, scheduled polling cycles, bursty event traffic, and transactional API writes — each
 



 with different latency, ordering, and backpressure characteristics.
 



 • Normalize collected data into a common internal model, applying OpenTelemetry semantic
 



 conventions where they fit and defining consistent conventions where they don't, so
 



 downstream consumers see one shape regardless of source.
 



 • Build the data substrate for anomaly and signal detection — streaming aggregation, rollingwindow state, baselining, and correlation across metrics, logs, and traces — and integrate
 



 model inference into the ingestion and query path within latency and resource budgets.
 



 Own system design for your modules — write and defend design notes covering data
 



 model, interfaces, scaling limits, failure modes, and rollback.
 



 • Debug production problems end to end — reproduce, isolate, instrument, and fix issues
 



 including performance regressions and platform\-specific behavior.
 



 • Use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows as part of the normal development loop,
 



 while retaining full ownership of correctness, security, and design quality of the generated
 



 output.
 



 • Write clean, testable, well\-instrumented code, participate in code reviews, and contribute
 



 to design and engineering documentation.
 



 • Collaborate with product managers, and fellow engineers to deliver high\-quality features.
 



 • Continuously learn and apply modern development practices and tools.
 



  





**Skills and Qualifications:** 




  





**•** 
 B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, IT
 



 • Minimum 3 years of hands\-on backend engineering, with production\-level proficiency in Go and the
 



 ability and appetite to work in Rust.
 



 • Demonstrable experience in the observability domain: metrics, logs, traces, agents, collectors,
 



 monitoring systems, or telemetry pipelines.
 



 • Working knowledge of cloud and distributed systems — containers, Kubernetes, service\-to\-service
 



 communication, and the standard distributed failure modes (partial failure, backpressure, retries,
 



 idempotency).
 



 • Strong debugging and production problem\-solving ability using profilers, tracing, logs, and metrics.
 



 • Experience with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus or similar observability infrastructure.
 



 • Strong reasoning and first\-principles problem\-solving — the ability to break down an unfamiliar
 



 problem, form a hypothesis, and test it, rather than pattern\-matching to a previous solution.
 



 • Adaptive mindset — comfortable with changing priorities, evolving requirements, and switching
 



 between languages, platforms, and modules.
 



 • AI\-ready working style — treats AI tooling as leverage, prompts and reviews critically, and
 



 understands where generated code needs to be challenged.
 



 • A strong reading and self\-learning habit — follows source code, specifications, and engineering
 



 blogs, and can bring what they read back into the product.
 



 • Working comfort with statistical concepts as applied to time\-series (distributions, seasonality,
 



 percentiles, drift) and the ability to implement a detection algorithm from a specification or paper.
 



 • Ownership and accountability — takes a module from design through production support, raises
 



 risks early, and does not treat a handoff as the end of responsibility

title: MIS Executive
description:
* **Job Title** 
 : MIS Executive \- IHA Reporting
* **Location** 
 : Ahmedabad
* **Company Domain** 
 : US Healthcare
* **Employment** 
**Type** 
 : Full\-Time
* **Experience:** 
 2\-3 Years
* **Shift:** 
 Night



  





**Job Description:** 




  





**About the Role** 




  




* The MIS Executive supports the IHA Reporting Team by preparing, validating, analyzing and distributing recurring and ad hoc operational reports. The role converts data from approved sources into accurate, timely and easy\-to\-understand information that helps stakeholders monitor performance, identify exceptions and make informed decisions.
* The role is responsible for maintaining reporting schedules, reconciling outputs, documenting report logic, responding to reporting requests and continuously improving recurring work through standardization and appropriate automation.
* ROLE OUTCOMEDeliver dependable reports and practical business insights while maintaining strong data accuracy, process discipline and stakeholder responsiveness.








**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Report Preparation and Delivery** 



* Prepare and distribute assigned daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and ad hoc operational reports within agreed timelines.
* Maintain report calendars, distribution lists, source locations, dependencies and delivery evidence for assigned reports.
* Follow approved report formats, naming standards and communication protocols.
* Coordinate with report owners and stakeholders when source data, requirements or timelines change.



  





**2\. Data Collection and Validation** 



* Extract and consolidate data from approved databases, applications, Excel files and other authorized sources.
* Validate completeness, record counts, filters, calculations, date ranges and business rules before releasing reports.
* Reconcile report outputs against source data or control totals and investigate exceptions, duplicates or missing records.
* Escalate unresolved data\-quality or system issues with clear examples, business impact and supporting evidence.



  





**3\. Data Analysis and Business Insights** 



* Analyze operational results to identify trends, variances, outliers and performance gaps.
* Prepare concise observations that explain what changed, where attention is required and what additional review may be needed.
* Support leadership and operational teams with drill\-downs and ad hoc analysis based on approved requirements.
* Present data in a clear format using tables, charts, dashboards and summary views appropriate to the audience.



  





**4\. Reporting Tools and Automation** 



* Use advanced Excel functions, PivotTables, charts, lookups and formulas to build and maintain reporting solutions.
* Use SQL to retrieve, join, filter and summarize data from approved reporting databases.
* Build and maintain Power BI reports or dashboards where assigned and authorized.
* Identify repetitive reporting steps that can be standardized or automated and coordinate improvements with team leadership and automation resources.
* Support controlled automation of report generation and delivery through approved email, folder or FTP processes where applicable.



  





**5\. Documentation and Controls** 



* Maintain report definitions, data dictionaries, query logic, calculation rules, SOPs, process maps and backup instructions.
* Apply version control and change documentation to prevent unapproved or unexplained modifications.
* Maintain confidentiality and comply with approved privacy, security, access and data\-handling requirements.
* Ensure critical reports have documented quality checks and continuity coverage.



  





**6\. Stakeholder Support and Team Collaboration** 



* Understand reporting requirements, clarify expected outcomes and communicate delivery status professionally.
* Respond to reporting questions with relevant data, clear explanations and appropriate supporting detail.
* Collaborate with MIS colleagues, Automation Analysts, Operations, Planning, BI and other departments to resolve reporting dependencies.
* Participate in team huddles, knowledge\-sharing sessions, process reviews and training activities.








**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Applications, Computer Science or a related field.
* Minimum 2 to 3 years of hands\-on experience in MIS reporting, operational reporting, data analysis or a comparable role.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables, lookup functions, conditional formulas, charts and data validation.
* Working knowledge of SQL, including joins, filters, aggregations and data\-quality checks.
* Experience preparing recurring and ad hoc reports in a deadline\-driven environment.
* Strong numerical ability, analytical thinking, attention to detail and problem\-solving skills.
* Good written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain report results to business stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain accuracy and work effectively in a fast\-paced environment.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience supporting US healthcare, In\-Home Assessment, contact\-center, provider, planning or operations reporting.
* Working knowledge of Power BI, including data preparation, visual design and dashboard maintenance.
* Experience with Excel macros/VBA, Python or other reporting automation tools.
* Knowledge of database concepts, MySQL, scheduled reporting, FTP or automated email distribution.
* Exposure to process mapping, root\-cause analysis, Lean Six Sigma or continuous\-improvement methods.
